correctness.rationale: The complete weight-three, degree-three reduced Świątkowski differential from integral half-edge boundaries is exactly 4752 by 1760. Two exact prime-field eliminations both return 1756, bounding rational nullity by four; four explicitly signed, disjoint-support integral 3-torus cycles are killed by the differential and each has primitive unit coordinates. They form the entire integral kernel, with no degree-four chains at weight three. Explicit action on the full chain basis proves all 96 S4 transformations give z_j to z_sigma(j) with sign +1; coordinate-sum argument proves the invariant-line nonsplitting. Actual package verifier replay and known integral chain comparison theorem support the result.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The general chain model applies to T but does not determine its kernel: applying a theorem is not the same as its input-dependent computation. The inspected high-degree unitrivalent theorem concerns degree equal to the number of essential trivalent vertices, not degree 3 at weight 3 for 12 trivalent vertices. Planar second-homology generation statements have a different target degree and do not imply this integral top rank and symmetry; product cycles known generally need not be a complete basis.
